notes: The opening «روي عن حارث» gives the first link; the asker is not named, so the Imam written as asked («أنه سئل أبو عبد الله») is the last link.
«بياع الأنماط» is an epithet kept inside the name as written.

fixes.reason: RWY reads the verb «روي» as the first link; the text's first name is حارث.
